title: China Declares Taiwan Restoration Day Amid Tensions
description: China announced the creation of the Commemoration Day of Taiwan's Restoration, emphasizing its claims over Taiwan. The holiday will observe October 25, marking Taiwan's handover from Japan in 1945. The move underlines China's stance on Taiwan’s political status and adds to the cross-strait tensions.
